evidence.detail: The enclosing rs/n/c/b is already reviewed as DailyChallengesInterface and owns the static List<rs/n/c/b$a> rendered into its 441xx challenge rows.
The record stores challenge name, challenge description and four integers populated together by DailyChallengesInterface.a(String,String,int,int,int,int).
Parent rendering uses the final two integers as current and goal progress, derives a percentage capped at 100%, updates the progress bar sprite, and writes current/goal/percent text.
The same entry row is rendered beside the exact action 'Collect reward', with the entry name also used for the challenge information tooltip path.

candidates.note: Descriptive semantic recovery from exact-v308 Daily Challenges entry behavior; original stripped source identifier is not claimed.
